description.text:
Summon Deva
(Conjuration/Summoning)

Level: Quest
Range: 30 ft.
Duration: 3 turns
Casting Time: 9
Area of Effect: Special
Saving Throw: None

A deva answers the call and fights at the caster's side until the spell ends or it falls in battle. It follows the caster's orders, and the caster chooses which of its spells it casts. The party can have one deva or fallen deva and one planetar or dark planetar at the same time. A second of the same kind leaves as soon as it arrives.

Deva: 14 Hit Dice, chaotic good
STR 19, DEX 18, CON 18, INT 18, WIS 18, CHA 20
Hit Points 136, AC -5, THAC0 4, saving throws 3/5/4/4/6
2 attacks per round with a Heavy Mace +3: 1d10+10 crushing damage. Undead that are hit must save vs. Death at -4 or be destroyed. Every hit has a 50% chance to stun for 2 rounds unless the target saves vs. Spell.

Only weapons of +2 or better can hit it. It cannot be affected by level drain, death magic, imprisonment, maze, petrification or poison.
Resistances: cold and electricity 100%, fire 50%, magic 70%, physical damage 10%.

Spells by level:
1: Bless (x3); Remove Fear (x3)
2: Aid (x3); Find Traps; Know Alignment; Draw Upon Holy Might
3: Remove Curse (x2); Holy Smite (x2); Cure Disease (x2)
4: Cure Serious Wounds (x2); Neutralize Poison (x2); Protection From Evil, 10' Radius
5: Raise Dead; True Seeing; Mass Cure
6: Blade Barrier; Heal
7: Holy Word
